description:
FILED s458ak from the #841 probe battery.  REPRO: my $h={k=>"v"}; my $r=\$$h{k}; $$r="W"; print $h->{k}, ref($r);  -- perl W/SCALAR, PCL v/(empty string).  Same for \${$h}{k} and \$$a[0].  The ARROW spellings \$h->{k} and \$a->[0] are CORRECT (W3/SCALAR, X2/SCALAR), and so is the named \$n{k}.  THE EMISSION SHOWS THE BUG DIRECTLY: `my $r = \$$h{k}` lowers to (p-my-= $r (p-gethash (p-cast-$ $h) "k")) -- no p-backslash and no -box accessor at all, so $r holds the VALUE and the later (p-setf (p-cast-$ $r) "W") writes into a non-ref.  So this is a PARSE/lowering bug in the \ + sigil-deref-with-subscript shape, not a runtime one; suspect the term walker consumes \$$h as the operand and then re-attaches the {k} subscript to the DEREF rather than to the backslashed term.  SILENT WRONG twice over (the ref is not a ref, and the write is lost).  BAR: the p861 probe (6 rows, 3 currently wrong) vs perl, a guard row, corpus-diff + sweep.

DONE s459an (agent AN, round 16).  CAUSE: PPI tags `\` PPI::Token::Cast like the sigils, so Pl::PExpr::_cast_run_start walked over it and the subscript builder saw a TWO-cast run -- the #305 widened path, which accounts for the whole run and SPLICES it, the backslash included.  FIX: one line in that ONE shared helper (`\` ends the run); NO $end_pars / _reduce_term change, so the region prohibition does not apply -- the grammar the review doc states (cast := $ @ % & *) is exactly the rule restored.  Fixes all four spellings plus the chained \$$d{x}[0]{y}.  Emission-IDENTICAL over corpus 111 + shapes 6 + perl's own t/ 605 + lib 22 (RCDIFF 0); the shape occurs in NO population (every grep hit is an escaped \$ inside a string), so probes + guard rows are the bar per s371.  Guard Pl/t/lvalue-ref-01.t 18 -> 23, rows 19-22 inverse-verified failing at base while row 23 (the multi-cast non-regression shapes) passes on both sides.  RESIDUE FILED #892: `\` still does not distribute over a SLICE -- independent (the cast-free \@A[0,1] is wrong identically), though this fix moved \@$a[0,1] from one ARRAY ref into that family.
subject: backslash + sigil-deref-with-subscript LOSES THE BACKSLASH: \$$h{k} / \${$h}{k} / \$$a[0] never take a reference and the write goes nowhere (the arrow spellings are correct)
